checker_script.discovery_method: Auto-discovers the live (non-superseded) *-consolidated-kpi DSSE file by scanning evidence/phase0/kpis/*consolidated-kpi*.json and evidence/phase0/repairs/*/done/*consolidated-kpi*.dsse.json, then excluding any candidate named by another candidate's own supersedes.superseded_path. On this run this correctly resolved to the R-N03 v3 index (which itself supersedes the R-A08 v2 index named in this item's objective text), not a hardcoded path -- so the gate does not itself go stale across future repairs the way the index it checks did.
checker_script.does_not_verify_signatures: By design: completeness (does every on-disk receipt appear in the index?) is orthogonal to authenticity (is the index validly signed?). Signature authenticity of evidence/audit/ receipts against the pinned Phase-0 key is independently audited by evidence/audit/consolidated-kpi-staleness-v1/run_staleness_audit.py's T1.
checker_script.identity_key_rationale: 3 of the 8 on-disk evidence/audit/ receipts (eis-reproducibility-discrimination-power-v1, eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-v1, multi-instrument-concordance-v1) are stored in the live v3 index's audit_verdicts_index with audit_id: null (their own signed payloads carry no explicit audit_id field). receipt_path is always present and unambiguous in every index entry and every on-disk receipt's path, so it -- not audit_id -- is the correct, robust completeness key. Verified directly against the live v3 payload before choosing this design (see decode excerpt this fire's session log; not re-included here to avoid duplicating the KPI's own content).

claim_under_test.claim_text: A committed checker script detects within one run any signed audit receipt absent from the consolidated index (the defect that recurred twice).

does_not_close: No coating-efficacy, product-performance, batch-release, or corrosion-rank authority.
Does not re-derive, dispute, or modify any individual audit's own statistics.

Does not modify, delete, or re-sign the live v3 consolidated-kpi index, any evidence/audit/ receipt, the v1/v2 superseded indices, the ledger, or the manifest; all remain byte-intact and referenced by path + sha256. The tempdir mutation exists only under /tmp and touches no file inside the module tree.

This is a detector, not an enforced gate: nothing currently invokes check_index_completeness.py automatically pre-commit or in CI for this module; wiring it into an actual build/CI hook is future work this receipt does not claim to have done.

The identity_key=receipt_path design choice means a receipt whose index entry has the correct path but a corrupted/wrong audit_id would NOT be flagged by this gate; it checks presence, not full-entry fidelity.
objective_summary: The 2026-08-03T04:00 fire (consolidated-kpi-staleness-v1) recommended a build-time CI gate over manual re-indexing (see its does_not_close: 'Phase-1 fix: build-time completeness check'). This delivers that gate as check_index_completeness.py, committed at evidence/phase0/kpis/check_index_completeness.py (sha256 5c97ede24e63de5a34ca3da2e0df32a7b0e0289a14df254869b82efb478b412f), executable, and re-runnable against any module-root.

positive_control.evidence: check_index_completeness.py --module-root /tmp/r-s07-positive-control exited 1 (FAIL_STALE_INDEX) with missing_from_index == ['evidence/audit/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-v1/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-receipt.v1.dsse.json'], matching exactly the one receipt whose index entry was deleted -- and only that one; extra_in_index_not_on_disk == [] confirms no other diff was introduced.
positive_control.how_planted: Copied evidence/audit, evidence/phase0/kpis, evidence/phase0/repairs verbatim into a tempdir, then edited the DSSE payload of the copied live index file (evidence/phase0/repairs/R-N03/done/audit-verdicts-consolidated-kpi.v3.dsse.json) to remove the single audit_verdicts_index entry whose receipt_path == 'evidence/audit/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-v1/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-receipt.v1.dsse.json' (entries 8 -> 7), re-base64'd the payload in place, left signatures[] byte-unchanged (now stale/invalid, which is expected and irrelevant to this completeness-only check), and left the on-disk receipt file for that audit completely untouched.
positive_control.planted_defect: In a tempdir copy only, deleted the eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-v1 audit's entry (receipt_path=evidence/audit/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-v1/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-receipt.v1.dsse.json) from the copy of the live consolidated-kpi index's audit_verdicts_index, while leaving the real signed receipt file for that audit present and unmodified on disk in the same tempdir.

refutation_criterion_considered: This checker WOULD have been refuted by: (a) exiting 0 (silently passing) against the tempdir copy with the planted gap, or (b) exiting nonzero against the real, currently-clean live index (false positive), or (c) the two live replay runs producing different stdout bytes (non-determinism). None of (a), (b), (c) occurred; observed instead: real run exit 0 / 0 missing / byte-stable replay, tempdir run exit 1 / exactly the one planted gap named.

reproducibility.two_replay_note: The checker's own stdout was independently confirmed byte-identical across two live runs (see run_against_live... .stdout_byte_identical_across_replay). The signed receipt payload below additionally passes this module's standard canonical two-replay sha256 gate (see two_replay_sha256_gate).

positive_control_build_summary.how_planted: Copied evidence/audit, evidence/phase0/kpis, evidence/phase0/repairs verbatim into a tempdir, then edited the DSSE payload of the copied live index file (evidence/phase0/repairs/R-N03/done/audit-verdicts-consolidated-kpi.v3.dsse.json) to remove the single audit_verdicts_index entry whose receipt_path == 'evidence/audit/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-v1/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-receipt.v1.dsse.json' (entries 8 -> 7), re-base64'd the payload in place, left signatures[] byte-unchanged (now stale/invalid, which is expected and irrelevant to this completeness-only check), and left the on-disk receipt file for that audit completely untouched.

run_against_tempdir_with_hidden_receipt.tempdir_construction: Not by touching real files. A fresh tempdir mirrors evidence/audit/, evidence/phase0/kpis/, evidence/phase0/repairs/ verbatim from the real module, then the copied live index file's DSSE payload is edited to delete exactly one audit_verdicts_index entry (receipt_path == evidence/audit/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-v1/eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-receipt.v1.dsse.json), while the corresponding receipt file itself is left present and untouched on disk in the tempdir -- reproducing exactly the shape of the recurring defect: a real signed receipt exists, the index was not rebuilt to reference it.

verdict_rationale: The claim under test is that a committed checker script detects, within one run, any signed audit receipt absent from the consolidated index. Two required observations, both captured this fire: (1) against the real, live, R-A08-then-R-N03-refreshed index the checker exits 0 with zero missing (a checker that only ever passes is not evidence on its own, which is why (2) is required) -- (2) against a tempdir copy with one receipt's index entry deliberately hidden (the exact recurring defect class), the same unmodified checker exits 1 and names precisely that one receipt as missing. The claim withstands this test: CLAIM_SURVIVED.
